title: review: fix round 1 for T-0771: PoolSel must not depend on live role_affinity (planner on B)
spec:
Fix round 1 for T-0771 (same worktree, branch already has f601396). The base suite has a SECOND live-config dependency: tests/test_pool.py::PoolSel::test_affinity_reserve_cooldown_budget asserts pick("planner") -> "A" at line 38, but .orchestrator/pool.toml line 15 gives account B planner affinity too (user decision 2026-09-21 18:40, must stay), so with A at 0.7 of its window and B idle the pool picks B: `AssertionError: 'B' != 'A'`. The test encodes the pre-change config through the harness copy of pool.toml.
Do: make PoolSel independent of the live role_affinity lists. In PoolSel.setUp (tests/test_pool.py:28-29), after building self.p, set the accounts' affinity explicitly to the shape the assertions assume (A: planner, scout, triage, execute, review, spec_review; B: scout, triage, review, challenge, execute, spec_review, no planner) using whatever attribute Pool.Account exposes for role affinity (read orchestrator/pool.py to find it; if affinity is only read from cfg at pick time, patch self.p's cfg copy instead). Add one comment line: "affinity fixed here so the suite never depends on the live pool.toml (planner was added to B on 2026-09-21)". Do not edit .orchestrator/pool.toml. Do not change any assertion. Every other PoolSel test must still pass.
Then run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green and commit on the current branch with a message starting with T-0771.

Acceptance criteria are not met.

comments.issue: Spec required patching PoolSel.setUp to pin account role_affinity explicitly (independent of .orchestrator/pool.toml) so test_affinity_reserve_cooldown_budget's `pick("planner") == "A"` assertion at line 38 holds regardless of live config. No such change was made — setUp is still just `P.PERSIST.unlink(...); self.p = P.Pool()`. Running the test confirms it still fails: `AssertionError: 'B' != 'A'`, because .orchestrator/pool.toml gives account B planner affinity (2026-09-21 decision).
